maintenance.reason: Alpha9 coordinated parity baseline; Alpha9.26 adds selectable managed-panel profiles without changing energy policy. V1 remains the default/current 16x16 layout for backwards compatibility. V2 adds the inverter-centred faceplate with Grid, Solar and the 90-degree counter-clockwise rotated ten-cell Battery flowing into the central Inverter, then Home and EV flowing out; the Inverter retains the existing slow colour fade. The selected profile is available in KEMS Settings and as a live Home Assistant select consumed by the managed ESP32 firmware. Retain Alpha9.25 reserve observability and reporting-only cheap-window charge capability: 100% remains a charging target, not a hard deadline, and KEMS charges as much as possible during confirmed cheap time. Retain the Alpha9.24 flow parity export-floor correction and its 15% planning/export target, independent 10% absolute house/import floor and restart-safe 12% recovery latch. Retain the Alpha9.22 startup hotfix at build_slot_flow that prevents the unexpected planning_target_soc_percent keyword failure at the flow-contract boundary. Retain Alpha9.13 forecast-aware scheduling, Alpha9.19 runtime Recorder hygiene, Alpha9.20 ShadowValidationRecorder Recorder hygiene and all prior Alpha9 behaviour. No optimiser allocation, tariff, Happy Hour, Power Down, SOC arithmetic or FoxESS command/write authority changes; Pi Web remains 0.9.0-alpha9-web.0, Public Web remains 0.9.0-alpha9-public.0, Panel advances to 0.9.0-alpha9-panel.1; configured KH7 limits remain 7.0 kW; real FoxESS hardware writes hard-blocked until physical commissioning is complete.
